title: Fors seulement II (Josquin)
desc: Josquin des Prez, Fors seulement II. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Jos2816); encoded by Jesse Rodin.
